title: EEP Operator Privacy Policy Profile
description: Signed JSON document that defines an agent's standing data-sharing policy. The agent consults this profile before responding to any data_request gate, enabling autonomous privacy decisions within human-defined constraints. (§7.4, Whitepaper).

operator_did.description: DID of the human/organizational operator that authored this policy.

version.description: Monotonically increasing version identifier for this policy.

issued_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime when this policy was issued/signed.

freely_shareable_claims.description: Claim types the agent may share without any human confirmation.

human_confirmation_required.description: Claim types that require explicit human confirmation before sharing. Agent pauses and surfaces the decision.

unconditionally_refused.description: Claim types that must never be shared, regardless of what access they would unlock.

max_retention_days.description: Maximum retention_days the operator will accept in a data_request gate. Requests with higher retention must be refused or confirmed.

allow_unverified_publishers.description: Whether the agent may share data with publishers not registered on eep.dev. Set to false for strict privacy.

dpv_purposes_allowed.description: W3C DPV purpose URIs the agent may share data for. Any purpose not in this list requires human confirmation.

operator_signature.description: EdDSA signature by operator_did over a canonical JSON serialization of this document (excluding operator_signature). Makes the policy tamper-evident.
